steps.help: Step 1 of 3: Your dashboard shows all your pending assignments. Each card shows the form name, due date, completion status, and progress percentage.
Step 2 of 3: Each assignment card shows the template name, period, due date, and current status. Overdue assignments have a red border and "Overdue" badge.
Step 3 of 3: Click on the assignment title to open the data entry form. You can see completion percentage and status before clicking.
